Bryan (PM): quick sync — customer (LargeAnalytics) is asking for: higher on-demand burst, an SLA-backed priority lane for critical requests, and per-route soft-quotas. they want this in Starter tier if possible. how do we prioritize vs launch risk?
Dana (Eng): starter tier changes are risky for infra. priority lane = extra routing + reserved capacity. two options: a) add 'priority add-on' (extra $/month + per-token premium) or b) raise starter baseline (simpler rollout but hurts conversion).
Rafael (Sales): for this customer they're willing to sign a 12mo if we include a modest burst add-on and a 99.9% P99 SLA for priority. other mid-market deals asked too — this is recurring ask.
Ivy (Finance): need modeled uplift. quick calc: if add-on is $1k/mo and we get 20% attach rate from similar customers, ARR impact ~ $240k per 100 customers. raising base tier by $X reduces conversion — need A/B projection.
Sahil (ProdOps): operationally, priority lane needs runbook, throttles, and monitoring. rollout criteria: canary on Dedicated customers first, feature-flag for Hosted, alerting on queue length + P99 latency.
Ravi (Infra): infra constraints: reserved pools for priority add-on increase resource fragmentation. if we do dynamic soft-assign with preemptible spillover it's doable but requires 2 wks infra work + 1 wk testing.
Lin (Support): support impact: docs + new escalation path. if we promise an SLA need an SLO dashboard and on-call rotation updates.
Bryan (PM): here's a strawman proposal:
```
- Offer Priority Lane as an add-on for Starter and Standard.
- Pricing: $1k/mo + 10% per-token premium on priority requests.
- Limits: 5x baseline burst, soft-quotas with automated fallback to Standard model variant.
- Launch criteria: infra can canary + 2 successful enterprise pilots, ops runbook, finance signoff on pricing.
```
Dana (Eng): estimate: infra changes 3w dev (2 infra engs), 1w QA, work to support feature flags + routing. api surface small (new header + flag).
Rafael (Sales): that's workable for the immediate deal if we can commit pilot in 6 weeks. customer asks for SLA start date tied to rollout — can do pilot SLA at lower uptime (99.7) then raise after GA.
Ivy (Finance): can we add a clause: introductory discount for pilot (50% first 3 months) and evaluate attach rate before GA pricing? that reduces short-term ARR but reduces friction.
Sahil (ProdOps): launch checklist (minimum):
- Canary on Dedicated (2 clusters)
- Observability: per-route P99, queue depth, cost-per-token breakdown
- Fallback policy validated under 2 simulated overload patterns
- Runbook + SLO page published
- Support training session scheduled

Ravi (Infra): I'll prioritize infra PRs if we have exec buy-in. need product spec by EOD Friday to scope sprint.
Bryan (PM): next steps: Rafael to lock pilot customer timeline, Dana+Ravi to produce prod spec + rough task breakdown, Ivy to run quick revenue sensitivity, Sahil to draft runbook template. Can everyone ack? :point_down:
Rafael (Sales): ack — will confirm pilot start date by Tue.
Dana (Eng): ack — will draft spec and drop PR numbers by Fri.
Ivy (Finance): ack — will send model with 3 pricing variants by Thu.
Sahil (ProdOps): ack — will prepare runbook template and SLO metrics.
Ravi (Infra): ack — will estimate infra effort in spec.
Lin (Support): ack — tentatively schedule training 2 weeks after canary signoff.
deploy-bot: Documentation page created: https://go.redwood.dev/priority-lane-spec (internal) :white_check_mark:
Bryan (PM): thanks team — i'll collect all inputs and propose final decision at Wed product sync.
